title: Fugue
note: Hand-authored for games/fugue (the one-player suites the gate can drive at real speed: the timed multiplayer set is replayed by tests/fugue_rules.mjs instead). The gate reads this file.
rules: Three or more players. Every round one player is the CONNECTIONIST and the rest are STREAMERS. Each streamer has their own secret prompt and must lock a word every 3 seconds (type it, hit space - like an email address turning into a bubble). The connectionist sees every locked word and forges links, one word from each of two or more streams, that fit a relation which snaps to a new one after every link. Straight vertical links and links reaching more streams score more. Afterwards the streamers vote on every link. Only the connectionist scores; everyone takes a turn, then the set is compared. On a one-player table the lobby offers two solo modes: Stream (timed word locking from a prompt) and Connect (three books, drawn from the bank baked by scripts/bake-fugue-words.py, drip words; the player is the connectionist and every link stands unjudged).
